records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ハンスさんよお
そろそろアフリカにあるっていう
『証』とやらの手がかりが見つかっても
いいんじゃねえの？
records.English:
Hans, isn't it about time we found 
 a clue to the Proof of Conquest
 in Africa?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese: そうあせっても仕方があるまい
records.English: No use rushing.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
でも…、どうやって
その手がかりを探せばいいんでしょう？
records.English: But... how do we find a clue?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
まずは何よりも、『覇者』にふさわしい
“力”を付けることじゃ。これが
なくては、『証』のほうが決して
振り向いてはくれん
records.English:
First and foremost, you need power 
 worthy of someone who would rule 
 the seas. Without it, the Proof
 will never reveal itself to you.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
力ってのは、でっかい艦隊を持つって
ことか？
records.English: By power, you mean a huge fleet?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
それとも…、航海者として
一人前になることなのかな？
records.English: Or... becoming a capable seafarer?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
いえ、“財力”という意味かも
しれませんよ
records.English: Perhaps wealth.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ふうむ…。大きな交易圏を持つ
ということかのう？
records.English: Hmm. A big trading network?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
人それぞれにいろいろな解釈が
あるものじゃな。ひょっとしたら
その全てなのかもしれん
records.English:
Everyone has a different 
 interpretation. Perhaps it means 
 all of those things.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うわあ…！
気の遠くなるような話ですね
records.English: Wow... That's a daunting task.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese: しかし、力を持つだけではダメじゃ
records.English: But power alone isn't enough.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ええっ！？　他にもあるんですか？
records.English: What?! There's more?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
あくまでもこれはわしの推論
なのじゃが…
records.English:
This is only my own theory,
 mind you...

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
『証』の謎は、世界各地の遺跡に
封印されておる可能性が高い
records.English:
I believe the secrets of the Proofs
 are likely sealed within ruins 
 around the world.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 遺跡…ですか？
records.English: Ruins?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese: そうじゃ
records.English: Yes.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 遺跡って、どこにあるんですか？
records.English: Where are the ruins?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
各地の文化圏を代表する
大きな都市の中か、そのそば
じゃろうな
records.English:
I'd look in or near
 the major cities of each region.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
それだけじゃ
やっぱり探しようがねえぜ
records.English:
That still doesn't tell us how 
 we're supposed to find them.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
そこに住んでおる者であれば
知っておる者もおるはずじゃ
まずは、その街の人々の信頼を得る
ことじゃな
records.English:
Some of the locals may know. First,
 you'll have to earn their trust.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 信頼を…？
records.English: Trust...?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
遺跡や古い教会は、彼らの宗教や
文化の象徴じゃ。よそ者のわしらには
そう簡単には教えてくれん
records.English:
Ruins and old churches embody
 their faith and culture. They won't
 readily share their locations
 with outsiders like us.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
街の人の頼みを聞く、何か困って
おるならば助ける、悪徳商人や
軍人に苦しめられておるならば
そやつらを懲らしめる…
records.English:
Do favors for the townspeople. Help
 them out of trouble. If crooked
 merchants or soldiers prey on them,
 teach them a lesson...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
へえ…
まるで慈善事業だな
records.English: Sounds like charity.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
どのみち、覇者たる資格を持つ
ためには、多くの人々の信頼を得られる
だけの器量が必要なのじゃ
records.English:
In any case, someone who would rule
 the seas needs the character 
 to earn the trust of many people.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ふう…
覇者になるっていうのは
大変なことなんですね
records.English:
Whew... It's hard to become the one
 who rules the seas.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
ふぉっふぉっふぉ、当たり前じゃ
今までに誰も成し遂げた者は
おらんのじゃからのう
records.English:
Ha ha ha! Of course it is. No one's
 ever done it.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: いいから、いいから。行きゃ分かるって
records.English:
Come on, come on. You'll understand
 when we get there.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ところで、FI
おまえ、海の男ってどう思う？
records.English:
Say, FI.
 What do you make of sailors?

records.Japanese: うーん。どう思うって言われても…
records.English: Hmm... That's hard to answer...

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
何言ってんだよ。エンリケ王子に
レオン公、くぅ～っ！　
かっこいいよなあ
records.English:
What are you talking about?
 Prince Henry, Duke Leon... 
 Man, they're really cool!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: 海はやっぱり、男のロマンだぜ！
records.English: The sea is a man's great adventure!

records.Japanese: まーた、始まった
records.English: Here he goes again...

records.Japanese:
だいたいね、船もないのに
どうやって海に出るんだい？
records.English:
That's all well and good, but
 how are we supposed to go to sea 
 without a ship?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ロマンのねえやつだなあ
男が夢を語ってるってえのに
records.English:
Where's your sense of adventure? 
 Can't a man dream?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: っと、着いたぜ
records.English: And... we're here!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese: やあ、来ましたね…
records.English: Ah, there you are...

records.Japanese: 船…だ…
records.English: A ship...

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
どうだい？　驚いただろ！
名前まで決まってんだぜ。その名も
ズバリ、『カルテイラ号』だ！！
records.English:
Well? Surprised? 
 We've even named her.
 Behold the Carteira!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ガラクタ同然の廃船を引き取って
俺とジェナスで修理したんだぜ
records.English:
Janus and I took on an old wreck.
 She was little more than scrap,
 but we fixed her up.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
まあ、今すぐってわけにはいかねえ
けどよ…。金をためて、いつかはな
records.English:
We can't sail until we save up.
 Someday, though, we'll set out.

records.Japanese: 行こう…
records.English: Let's go...

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese: えっ？
records.English: What?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: あ？
records.English: Huh?

records.Japanese:
クラウだって言ってただろ
海に出ようって！
お金だったらフリオじいさんに頼めば
何とかなるよ！
records.English:
You said we should go to sea, Clau!
 If we need money, we can ask Julio.

records.Japanese:
これから
フリオじいさんのところへ
行って来る！！
records.English: I'm going to see Julio right now!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: おい！　FI！
records.English: Hey, FI!

records.Japanese:
ジェナスと、クラウは修理を続けてて！
頼んだよー！！
records.English:
Keep fixing her up, Janus and Clau!
 I'm counting on you!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
おーい！　待てよ！
FIーーっ！！
records.English: Hey! Wait up, FI!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
やれやれ
結局あいつが一番
乗り気になっちまったな
records.English:
Would you look at that...
 He's more excited than we are!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
はは。クラウの十八番がうつりましたね
思い立ったらいても立ってもいられない
records.English:
Ha! Looks like he picked up
 your habit of charging ahead.
 Once he makes up his mind, 
 he can't sit still.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
あいつは、もともとああなんだよ
いつもは、そう見えねえけどさ
それより修理のほうは？
records.English:
He's always been like that. He just
 doesn't let it show much.
 So how are the repairs coming?

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
だいたい終わりましたよ
結局、私がほとんどやって…
records.English:
Almost done. Though if you ask me, 
 I did most of the work...

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
いーじゃねえか、細けえこと言うなって
思いっきり楽しんでたくせによ
records.English:
Don't sweat the small stuff. 
 You loved every minute of it!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
あはっ、そうなんですけどね
さて、我々も行きましょうか
フリオさんのところに
records.English:
Ha! That's true. Shall we head over
 to Julio's place too?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
おうよ
やっぱり、俺がついててやんねえとな
FIはよっ
records.English:
Yeah. FI needs someone at his
 side. That's me.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
はいはい。分かってます
行きましょう、行きましょう
records.English: Yes, yes. I know. Come on.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
何じゃと！？　まぁた前借りかっ！
クラウディオめっ！　けしからんっ！
なあにに使うつもりじゃっ！
records.English:
What?! Another advance, Claudio? 
 The nerve of you! What do you need 
 it for this time?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
…
いきなりどなるんじゃねえよ、じじい！
records.English: Don't just start yelling, old man!

records.Japanese: すみません。無理言って
records.English: Sorry. This is a lot to ask.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
おお、FAのとこの
ぼうやかい？
records.English:
Ah, you're the boy 
 from the FA family?

records.Japanese: ぶしつけで、ごめんなさい
records.English: Sorry for barging in like this.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
だから、今までのとは違うんだって
真面目にやるって、言ってんだろ？
けちけちしねえで、金ぐらい
貸せってえの
records.English:
This time's different. 
 We're serious! Quit being stingy 
 and lend us the money!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
おまえがまともに働いてるところなんぞ
見たことないわ
それで信用せいと言うのは甘すぎるわい
records.English:
I've never seen
 you do an honest day's work. 
 And you expect me to trust you?

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
うーん
ひとえに、日頃の行いですね…
records.English: Well... you do reap what you sow.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: ぐぐ…
records.English: Grr...

records.Japanese:
お願いします！！　フリオさん！
僕が言い出したことなんです！！
…どうしてもダメでしょうか？
records.English:
Please, Julio! It was my idea. 
 Could you lend us the money?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
うーむ。大金じゃからのう
FIぼうやに
頼まれてものう。…親父さんは何と
言っとるんじゃ？
records.English:
Hmm... It's a lot of money, even 
 with you asking, FI.
 What does your father say?

records.Japanese:
ここで、父さんには絶対頼りたく
ないんです。必ず返します！
どうかお願いします！！
records.English:
I won't turn to my father for this.
 Please. I swear I'll pay you back.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
うむうむ、感心じゃ
一人立ちというわけじゃな
…しかしのう。ううむ
決心は分かるが…
records.English:
You want to stand on your own. 
 I admire that. I can see you've
 made up your mind, but...

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
…あーそうかい、もう頼まねえよ
おい、行こうぜ
FI、ジェナス
records.English:
Enough. We won't ask again.
 Let's go, FI. 
 Janus, we're leaving.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
はいはい
分かりましたから、引っ張らないで
records.English: Yes, yes, coming. Stop dragging me.

records.Japanese:
…無理を言ってごめんなさい
失礼しました
records.English:
I'm sorry I asked so much of you.
 We'll see ourselves out.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
はあ～
とは言ってみたものの
どうすっかな
records.English:
Well, I said my piece... 
 Now what are we going to do?

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
FI、お父様には
なぜ、お願いしないのです？
records.English:
FI, why won't you ask your 
 father for help?

records.Japanese:
…父さんは、いつまでたっても
僕を子供扱いするんだ
船に乗るなんて反対するに決まってる
records.English:
Father still treats me as a child. 
 He'd never let me go to sea.

records.Japanese:
今、ここで何かやらなきゃ
なんにも変わらないんだ！
records.English:
Nothing will change unless I do
 something right now!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
うーむ、FI！
えれえ！　その意気だ！
男はやっぱ、そうでなくっちゃあ
いけねえな！
records.English:
That's the way, FI! 
 Now that's a real man!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
それはいいんですが
先立つものがありませんとねえ
男意気だけでは…
records.English:
We still need money to get started.
 Courage won't pay the bills.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
…それを言うんじゃねえって
はあ～
地道にやっていくしかねえのかなあ
records.English:
You had to bring that up... I guess
 we'll have to earn it bit by bit.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: おおーい
records.English: Heeey!

records.Japanese:
あれ、フリオさんだ
何だろう
records.English: That's Julio. What does he want?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: まだおったか。よかったよかった
records.English: You're still here! Good, good.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese: 何でしょう？
records.English: What is it?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: いろいろ考えたんじゃがのう…
records.English: I've been thinking it over...

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
あーじれってえな
早く言ってくれよ、じいさん
records.English: Out with it already, old man!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
そうじゃな
…うむ
FI、これを
records.English: Very well. FI, take this.

records.Japanese:
！！
これは！！
records.English: What?! This is...!

records.speaker: System money notice
records.Japanese: 金貨３００００枚を手に入れました！
records.English: Received 30,000 gold!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
いったん渡したんじゃから
ちゃんと利子をつけて
返してもらわんとな
records.English:
Now that I've lent it to you,
 I'll expect it back with interest.

records.Japanese:
は、はい！
がんばりますっ！
records.English: Y-yes! We'll work hard!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
じゃが、わしの資金の行く末が心配じゃ
というわけでな
見張ることに決めたぞい
records.English:
Still, I'm worried about where 
 my money will end up. I've decided 
 to keep my eye on it.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
分からんかのう
わしも船に乗ると言っとるんじゃ
records.English:
Don't you understand? I'm sailing
 with you.

records.Japanese: 本当ですか！？
records.English: Really?!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
おお、これはこれは
ベテラン航海士に乗船していただける
とは心強い
records.English:
A veteran navigator is joining us? 
 That's very reassuring.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
ベテランは、照れるぞい
…ちょっとブランクもあるでなあ
records.English:
A veteran, eh? You'll make me
 blush. It's been a while 
 since I last put to sea.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ふーん
ほんとに使えるのかあ～？
このじいさん
records.English: Will this old man really be any use?

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
失礼なことばかり言わないでください…
フリオさんは、航海士としても有名
なんですよ
records.English:
Show some respect. 
 Julio's a famous navigator.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
というわけで
FIや
おまえさんが艦長だよ
records.English: FI, you'll be captain.

records.Japanese:
僕が！？
だって、船はジェナスと、クラウが…
records.English:
Me?! But Janus and Clau
 rebuilt her...

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
このお金は、FOの
総帥である
FI・FAを
信用して貸すわけじゃ
責任者はおまえさんじゃよ
records.English:
You lead FO,
 FI FA. 
 I'm trusting you with this loan. 
 It's your responsibility.

records.Japanese:
ええっ、FO！？
そ、総帥ってそんな…
records.English: FO?! Me, its leader?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
世界の名だたる航海者たちが活躍する
海で、これから名を上げよう
としとるんじゃろ？　それくらいの
意気込みでなければならん
records.English:
Want to make a name for yourself 
 among the world's greatest sailors?
 Then set your sights high.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
つまり
FI・FAは
この船の艦長であり、艦隊の提督であり

FOの
総帥でもあるわけじゃ
records.English:
FI FA, 
 you're captain of this ship
 and admiral of the fleet.
 You lead FO, too.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
それとも何かい？　クラウディオに
総帥を任せるというなら、何かあった
ときに一生タダで働いてもらうことに
なるが…
records.English:
Or would you rather put Claudio
 in charge? If anything goes wrong, 
 he'll be working for me for free 
 for the rest of his life...

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: それでもいいんじゃな？
records.English: Still interested, Claudio?

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
そ、そいつは困るぜ！
いやあ、総帥は、やっぱ
FIだ
なっ、ジェナスくん！
records.English:
N-no, thanks! FI should lead.
 Right, Janus?

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
ええ
私も、総帥ってガラではないですよ
records.English:
Agreed. Leading a company hardly 
 suits me.

records.Japanese: で、でも…
records.English: B-but...

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
なあに
努力してくれれば、それでいいんじゃ
records.English:
Just give it your best. That's all 
 anyone can ask.

records.Japanese:
…分かりました！
やってみます！
records.English: All right! I'll give it a try!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
うむ、これで安心じゃな
その金は、最初の運転資金として
活用せい
records.English:
Good. Use the loan 
 as your starting capital.

records.Japanese:
ありがとうございます！
大事に使います！
records.English: Thank you! I'll use it wisely!

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
何から何まで
ありがたい限りですね
records.English: Julio, we can't thank you enough!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
おお！　じいさん
結構いいとこあるじゃねーか！
records.English:
Not bad, old man! Maybe you do have
 a decent side.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
な～にをぬかすか
若造が偉そうに
records.English:
Listen to you, acting so high and
 mighty, you young pup!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
んだと、くそじじい！
ほめてやってんじゃねえか！
records.English:
What was that, you old fossil? 
 I was giving you a compliment!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
…貴様は、ちっと痛い目を見んと
わしの偉大さが分からんようじゃな
records.English:
Maybe a good thump will
 teach you to recognize greatness.

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: おう？　やるか？
records.English: Oh yeah? You want a fight?

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
ふっふっふっ
まだまだ貴様なんぞに負けはせんわ！
records.English:
Heh heh heh! This old man can still
 beat a pup like you!

records.Japanese: やめてください！　２人とも！
records.English: Stop it, both of you!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
うんにゃ
こいつだきゃ、いっぺん拳固で
殴らんと気がすまん
records.English:
No! I won't be happy till I've 
 given this fool a good punch!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ほっほー？
そんなに指の骨、折りてえのかい？
records.English:
Oh yeah? You want
 to break your fingers that badly?

records.Japanese:
もう…！
艦長命令だ！　ケンカをやめろ！
records.English:
Enough! Captain's orders.
 Break it up!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: はいっ、艦長さんがそう言うなら！
records.English: Aye, Captain! Whatever you say!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: 艦長さんがそう言うなら！
records.English: Aye, Captain! Whatever you say!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese: あ、真似しやがったな！　じじい！
records.English: Hey! Don't copy me, old man!

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese: ふん。貴様なんぞの真似をするか
records.English: Hmph! As if I'd ever imitate you.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese: …やれやれですね
records.English: What a pair...

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
さて、バカはほっといて
そうと決まれば、『段取り八分』じゃ
航海に必要なものを揃えるとするかのう
records.English:
Never mind that fool.
 Getting ready is most of the work. 
 Let's gather what we need.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
いろいろと大変じゃが
しっかり、ついてきなされよ
records.English:
There's a lot to do, so stay close 
 and pay attention.

records.Japanese: はい！　教えてください！
records.English: Yes! Please teach me!

records.speaker: Claudio
records.Japanese:
ちぇっ、あのじいさん
ちょっと船のこと知ってるからって
すっかりFIの
先生気取りかよ
records.English:
Tch. Julio knows a little about
 ships, and suddenly he's acting
 like FI's teacher.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
はいはい
減らず口はそのくらいにして
行きますよ
records.English: Enough chatter, Claudio. Let's go.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
それでは航海に必要な準備を
始めましょう
records.English: Let's get ready for the voyage.

records.speaker: Janus
records.Japanese:
フリオさんに準備の仕方を
教わりますか？
それとも自分で出航の準備を
行いますか？
records.English:
Would you like Julio to show you 
 what to do, or would you rather
 prepare on your own?

records.Japanese: 教わろう
records.English: Ask him.

records.Japanese: 自分でできるよ
records.English: Prepare alone.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
うむ
では、準備にかかるとしよう
まずは交易所に行くかのう
records.English:
All right, let's get started.
 We'll head to the Market first.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
どんな街でも、出航前に
交易所・酒場・広場ぐらいは
まわった方がよいぞ
records.English:
Before you leave any town, 
 you should at least visit
 the Market, Tavern, and Square.

records.speaker: Julio
records.Japanese:
おお！　これは頼もしい
さあ、頑張っておくれよ
records.English:
Oh! That's reassuring. Well, 
 give it your best!
